import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import zoom
im=Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')

H,W=a.shape
# normalized coordinates: compute grid of (lo,hi) at tile centers
ts=160
ys=np.arange(ts//2,H,ts)
xs=np.arange(ts//2,W,ts)
LO=np.zeros((len(ys),len(xs)),np.float32)
HI=np.zeros_like(LO)
for ii,y in enumerate(ys):
    for jj,x in enumerate(xs):
        y1=max(0,y-ts//2); y2=min(H,y+ts//2)
        x1=max(0,x-ts//2); x2=min(W,x+ts//2)
        blk=a[y1:y2,x1:x2]
        lo=np.percentile(blk,3); hi=np.percentile(blk,97)
        LO[ii,jj]=lo; HI[ii,jj]=hi
# upsample lo,hi to full res with bilinear via scipy zoom
def up(M,shape):
    zy=shape[0]/M.shape[0]; zx=shape[1]/M.shape[1]
    U=zoom(M,(zy,zx),order=1)
    # pad/crop to shape
    out=np.zeros(shape,np.float32)
    h=min(shape[0],U.shape[0]); w=min(shape[1],U.shape[1])
    out[:h,:w]=U[:h,:w]
    out[h:,:]=U[h-1:h,:] if h>0 else out[h:,:]
    out[:,w:]=out[:,w-1:w] if w>0 else out[:,w:]
    return out
LOu=up(LO,(H,W)); HIu=up(HI,(H,W))
HIu=np.maximum(HIu,LOu+1)
b=np.clip((a-LOu)/(HIu-LOu)*255,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
Image.fromarray(b).save('clahe2.png')
print('ok')
EOF
